description: City of Melbourne CLUE Offstreet Car Parking is a series of datasets listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Local Government of Victoria - City of Melbourne. This dataset was collected as part of the City of Melbourne's Census of Land Use and Employment (CLUE). The data presents the number of off-street car parking spaces per property recorded in CLUE as points which represent each parking spot location. The data covers the year period of 2012. Coverage: Local Government of Victoria - City of Melbourne. The portal lists 16 near-identical datasets in this series (one per year, month, area or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher Local Government of Victoria - City of Melbourne. Its tags are 2012, capacity, census, clue, land. It offers 1 resource(s) in HTML. The portal shows 2025-07-31 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
